text: The README says how to use Invariant on your own repository: build the CLI from a clean checkout, add the gate with `invariant init`, require the gate with merge commits allowed, run `invariant watch`, then open an issue. It states what that needs, including Docker that runs linux/amd64 images, and what an issue costs by default. A coding agent tried it on a fresh repository first. #101 to #103 fix the code it found in the way, and the docs, which the factory can't take without Go tests, were changed by hand.
